board.$description: Classic walnut board. All four piece-on-square combinations ≥3:1; coordinates ≥4.5:1. Board themes are user-selectable independently of the UI theme.

on-light.$description: Rank/file label on light squares; 4.5:1 (coordinates are text).

outline.$description: Second channel: white pieces carry a dark outline so fill contrast never decides legibility alone.
Light outline for black pieces on dark squares.

border.$description: Border is the meaning channel for last move; fill alone is decoration.

icon.$description: Check always renders an icon inside the fill — never hue alone.

ring.$description: Ring guarantees 3:1 on dark squares where the ink fill cannot.
